context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 complete. CORS fix fully verified: hardcoded origins, middleware order, preflight for all 3 origins, admin login with CORS headers, GET /api/config with CORS headers. All 14 tests green. No issues remaining.
rca_of_issue: Root cause (fixed in iteration 8): (a) CORS origins depended on env var CORS_ORIGINS that Render did not inject, so allowed_origins was empty/broken; (b) CORSMiddleware was added after include_router which prevented it from intercepting preflight requests. Fix: origins hardcoded as CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS list + middleware moved before app.include_router(api_router). Both fixes confirmed working via 14 pytest tests.
